notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Happily_Ever_After/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Not_a_Hero/

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: MMS: Patch #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/beec01dcb615915c9cd59ed5694dd04f38846f8a.png[/img]

Hello mechanics!

Today we are releasing the next hotfix patch for Mech Mechanic Simulator. Most of the issues fixed here were pointed out to us by you, our community. Thank you for all the reports!

The patch introduces:
[list]
[*]The issue with accepting contract work and working on a garage mech has been resolved.
[*]The trophy case should now correctly display rewards gathered for completing the hardest missions.
[*]The screen settings now feature a Field of View slider.
[*]You can now use the W, S, A and D keys to adjust waves during scanning.
[*]The stock market share prices have been increased greatly increased.
[*]With the increase of share prices the stock bonus award from missions has been lowered.
[*]The amount of shares you can own is now limited by your reputation level (each corporation separately).
[*]All players that managed to buy a large number of shares before this patch went live will receive a special achievement as a thank you for finding this exploit.
[*]You can now perform a jump during the Agility calibration a few moments after you start falling.
[*]Pressing space (without holding) will now cause the mech to jump higher during the Agility calibration.
[*]Wall running during the Agility calibration now detects the player faster and lasts longer.
[*]Sliding during the Agility calibration now lasts longer.
[*]Multiple small issues with part assembly order have been fixed for Artemis, Hana and Wrath.
[*]Insanely large amounts of money will no longer cause the number to drop to 0 and trigger the bankruptcy event.
[*]The Depth of Field during mech assembly has been reduced.
[*]The main menu now has an FPS cap (when playing without VSync).
[/list]

We hope this patch will make the game more enjoyable!

notes.title: Mech Mechanic Simulator's methodical machinery repair is available now
notes.content:
Hayao Miyazaki once wrote that he didn't like mech anime because he thought the person who builds the machine should be the hero, not the person who pilots it. Here's your chance to be Miyazaki's hero.

Mech Mechanic Simulator is out now and it's about dismantling, repairing and rebuilding mechs for fun and profit. It's published by PlayWay, they of House Flipper, Car Mechanic Simulator and approximately a million other similar sims. Games in which you click without skill to perform every action, and games which I find endlessly fascinating.

Read more

notes.title: MMS: Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/beec01dcb615915c9cd59ed5694dd04f38846f8a.png[/img]

Hello mechanics!

What a day it's been! Mech Mechanic Simulator is finally live and since release we've seen a lot of suggestions from you. We want to thank you all for your continuous feedback and support!

Today, the team was hard at work to iron out a few of the most reported issues spotted by you, our players.

This patch introduces a few fixes and balance changes:

[list]
[*]The Electronics Station tutorial will no longer block you from finishing it if you restart the game before completing it.
[*]The Software Station tutorial now doesn't cause a job failure because of downgrading the software of a mech. Outside of the tutorial that rule still applies.
[*]The Agility Calibration now charges the Jump action faster (holding Space).
[*]The Combat Calibration turrets and drones deal less damage.
[*]The Mining Calibration flamethrowers now heat up the mech slower.
[*]The additional payment for finishing a Calibration has been increased.
[*]Parts will no longer spin during the Decorrosion and Welding process when a gamepad or joystick is connected.
[*]Multiple small optimization changes were made.
[/list]
We do hope that this patch will make the game much more enjoyable!

notes.title: MMS: Prologue Patch #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/9840988427878b5769cddce989768864cd979d03.png[/img]

Hello Mechanics!

While we are nearing the release of the Mech Mechanic Simulator full version we decided to patch the Prologue and apply the changes made for the release.

The changes introduced in this patch are:
[list]
[*] A new station has been added to the game: the tablet, which gives you access to the jobs menu from anywhere in the workshop („T” key).
[*] The scanning process has been completely redesigned and now requires you to adjust the scanner waves to the mech.
[*] The issue causing short freezes while travelling through the workshop has been resolved.
[*] The „replace part with a new one” objectives now have a very high chance to feature repaired parts instead of completely broken ones.
[*] The “repair part” additional objectives are no longer shown as the main objectives in the assembly station.
[*] The colour used to highlight the job objective parts has been changed to make it easier to spot.
[*] The parts that can be removed and those that block the disassembly now feature a new visual effect making them easier to spot.
[*] The prices of parts and stations have been changed to reflect the final game balance.
[*] The welding station now features a new tutorial explaining the process better.
[*] The welding station now calculates the part durability based on the precision of highlighting welding areas.
[*] The fuel of the welding station now drains much slower.
[*] The fuel of the cleaning station now drains faster.
[*] The tutorial is now more streamlined and shouldn’t cause the reported issues.
[*] Multiple smaller issues with the tutorial have been fixed.
[*] The sun now again creates god rays in the workshop.
[*] The android now asks you to buy a mechanics license after hitting 30,000$.
[*] Multiple mechs had their assembly order fixed to no longer block you from putting parts back.
[*] Several colours used on the mechs and in the painting station have been readjusted to no longer blend with other highlights.
[/list]We hope that these changes will make Mech Mechanic Simulator: Prologue a much more enjoyable experience.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1485350/Mech_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/

[*] six types of missions will be available and the prize for each of them will depend on the amount of danger eliminated.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog - Corporations
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we’re gearing up for the release of Mech Mechanic Simulator, we wanted to give you some insight into the game’s lore and tell you a little more about the corporations that will rule it’s world!

You will come across 4 different groups - the Sakura Corporation, Dauhasky Company, VI-CO and Hackers. Each of them with unique traits, mechs and paint jobs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/de99df7aa259de1b494443116b2a54bd2f402730.jpg[/img]

Sakura Corporation, as you’ve probably guessed, originates from the Japanese culture. It is a mix of tradition and technology - built on honor and self-sustainability, but not afraid to push the boundaries - they were the first to explore space in search of new resources. Usually, they are peaceful and like to boast about recent achievements on various shows and conferences, but don’t let that fool you! If necessary, they’ll start a conflict without a blink.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/182054f4fc58de8cf933809edffdbabd96ca1ef5.jpg[/img]

Dauhasky Company, on the other hand, has a Middle-Eastern vibe to it. It’s all about production, resources, luxury and quality. Their success is built mainly on mining, as they were one of the first in the world to discover deposits of new material. So, their machines may come out as heavier than others. This brought them huge amounts of money, which they like to spend on experimenting with technology or new materials. It also boosts their military power, as they can afford to buy mechs from other corporations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/a6aa1bec6b5946db1043e55e16c04b0e5cb05fdf.jpg[/img]

VI-CO is the type of corporation, which we can describe as “western”. Growing business is their key driver, hence they’re very aggressive in terms of expansion and marketing. If anyone stands in their way, war is the only solution and that’s why they put a lot of focus on firepower. They work as an umbrella company for multiple smaller producers. Numbers and growth are all that matters. If you can’t keep up - you’re out. Their mechs have an aggressive and military design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/249c3a25add03c6651c5e8d344ad9c66b6bcaf71.jpg[/img]

Hackers are on the opposite end of all this. They are a bunch of vigilantes, who like to operate in the shadows. Drawing from different cultures, they are all about freedom, crossing the borders and functionality. Officially, the black market for mech parts doesn’t exist, but in real life that’s what keeps them alive. They don’t care about rules or rights of other corporations and regardless of individual reasons, they’re all trying to fight the monopoly of 3 big companies. Obviously, Hackers add their own twist to their machines - unique paint jobs or some homemade modifications. Even though those mechs are not officially available, many customers see it as an opportunity - to save some money or use the machines for equally unofficial purposes...

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/aa6aa68487f203fc7896a17f3b3ddb05222269cc.png[/img]

Mechanics of the world, we have some great news to share with you all!

We have just released an update to our steam store page and with that comes two major things:

Now that we’re nearly done with the development of the game, and all that’s left for us is polishing and testing, we can finally reveal when you can expect Mech Mechanic Simulator to become available. You can start playing in [b]October![/b]

Additionally, with the update, we also published our gameplay trailer. We hope that it will not only answer some of your questions about the gameplay, but also make the wait a bit more bearable. You can watch the trailer here on our Steam Page but also on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5a9Z624gUbU]YouTube[/url].

notes.title: Mech Mechanic Simulator - it's getting real!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658622/8f4fd987e7424461a5be4e8a9646b62dc3bd5582.gif[/img]

[b][h1]Howdy Mechanics![/h1][/b]
It's been a couple of months since we, the [url=https://polyslash.com]Polyslash[/url] team, have been working on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1044980/Mech_Mechanic_Simulator/]Mech Mechanic Simulator[/url]. What have we done so far?

We've prepared [b]20 unique mech concepts[/b], designed [b]tasks[/b] and created a first version of your future [b]workshop[/b]. But, of course, we're focused on the best part - enormous machines waiting to be deconstructed, fixed and rebuilt. And we are hyped to show you this GIF - the very first sneak peek of what's gonna make your hands dirty!

What's coming up next? Add [b]Mech Mechanic Simulator[/b] to your wishlist and follow our [url=https://www.facebook.com/polyslash/]Facebook[/url] page to be on track. Next time we'll see each other there will be much more to talk about.

notes.title: New mechanics in town!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34658622/10697332d939a6affe0ac024ca54dceadeea3993.jpg[/img]

A huge announcement to all of you mech fans out there! We, the Polyslash team, are now the owners of the “Mech Mechanic Simulator”! 

Yesterday we started preparing to resume production of the title in our studio, and as soon as next week we will start working on it full force! We know that many of you are awaiting new information, and we promise to do everything we can to show you a few of our ideas very soon. 

So sit down, relax, and await more details!
